title: AlwaysBestHorse (ABH)
description: Always Best Horses is a lightweight, server-side Fabric mod. Whenever a player successfully tames a horse, its statistics are automatically maximized to the highest possible vanilla limits.
body:
Always Best Horse is a server-side Fabric mod designed to change horse taming mechanics. **Upon successfully taming a horse, the entity's primary statistics are automatically maximized to the highest possible vanilla limitations**, eliminating the necessity for extensive breeding processes.

Features

Stat Maximization: Instantly modifies the attributes of a tamed horse to the absolute vanilla maximums.

[
Maximum Health: **30.0** (15 Hearts)

Maximum Speed: **14.57** blocks per second

Maximum Jump Strength: **5.92** blocks
]

Server-Side Implementation: The modification operates entirely on the server. Clients joining the server are not required to install the mod locally to experience its features.

Administrative Control: Server operators possess the ability to toggle the modification's functionality globally in real-time without requiring a server reboot.

Commands

/ABH toggle – Toggles the maximum statistics feature **on** or **off**. (Requires Operator permissions)

/ABH help – Displays the administrative help interface and command usage. (Requires Operator permissions)

Technical Information

Mod Loader: Fabric

Dependencies: Fabric API

License: MIT License
